title: MSFS 2024 Update: DC Designs Concorde Released + 8 New Livery Packs!
description:
This April 26, 2026 Marketplace Update for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 on PC brings a standout release that will instantly grab the attention of airliner and supersonic fans alike — the DC Designs Concorde. If there’s one must-have aircraft from this week’s drop, it’s definitely Concorde, and it headlines a solid batch of new liveries joining the in-sim marketplace as well.

✈️ New aircrafts added this week (PC)
The following aircrafts were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 DC Designs: Concorde (A legendary supersonic airliner and the clear headline release of this week’s update)

🎨 New Liveries added this week (PC)
The following liveries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🎨 HRSimyard: H125 Nepal Livery Pack (A regional helicopter livery pack with Nepal-inspired designs)
🎨 Anov: Cubcrafters X-Cub STOL Livery Pack (A bush-flying focused livery pack for the X-Cub)
🎨 2Pilot: A320 V2 Europe Liveries (A European-themed livery collection for the A320 V2)
🎨 Stolt Addicts: Kodiak 100 Retro Defender Livery (A retro-style repaint for the versatile Kodiak 100)
🎨 HRSimyard: H125 US Medical Livery Pack (Medical service liveries for the H125 helicopter)
🎨 Captain Sim: 777-200ER FE Livery Pack 39 (Additional airline liveries for the 777-200ER FE)
🎨 Captain Sim: 777-Freighter Livery Pack 38 (New cargo liveries for the 777 Freighter)
🎨 Captain Sim: 777-300ER GE Livery Pack 37 (Fresh airline liveries for the GE-powered 777-300ER)
